title: gate_response
description: Schema for gate_response_NNNN_M.json artefacts produced by rl-operator-answerer (FR-008; Initiative_Orchestrator_Spec_v1_4 §14). Phase 4a P4-06.

gate_id.description: Must match the gate_id of the gate_request being answered.

selected_option.description: One of the options enumerated in the gate_request. Mutually exclusive with custom_text.

custom_text.description: Free-form answer when no enumerated option fits. Mutually exclusive with selected_option.

reasoning.description: Justification for the chosen answer; how the answerer arrived at it.

confidence.description: Self-assessed confidence in [0,1]. Compared against seed.gate_policy.confidence_threshold.

classification_check.description: Answerer's self-classification of the question class (matches FR-008 classification check).
